context: A police officer discusses tech cases
purpose: Teach: トヨタ自動車/最年少/サバイバル/プラネタリウム/温存/微細/立て続け/頑丈

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、トヨタ自動車、絶対、関連企業、絶対、警察、絶対、ご対応、絶対、依頼を受けております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We've received a request from Toyota and their affiliated companies. We're handling this with the utmost seriousness. Thank you for your patience.
lines.style: Level, measured opening. Professional but not cold. Even pacing, grounded in the lower register. The confidence of someone who has briefed people a hundred times.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 容疑者、本気で、絶対、最年少、絶対、で、絶対、驚きですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The suspect being the youngest person involved—that is surprising, isn't it.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Genuine curiosity mixed with a quiet concern. Slightly hesitant, as if thinking aloud. Soft landing on the question mark.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。被害者の、本気で、絶対、サバイバル、絶対、状況、絶対、警察、絶対、確認、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're carefully verifying the victim's situation and the circumstances of their survival.
lines.style: Steady, procedural tone. Each phrase deliberate and measured. No rushes or hedges. The voice of someone accountable for accuracy.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: プラネタリウム、本気で、絶対、施設での、絶対、事件、絶対、最近、絶対、ありましたよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: There was an incident at the planetarium facility recently, wasn't there.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost tentative. Drawing a line between two things. Slightly higher pitch on the connection, searching for confirmation. Genuine interest underneath.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。証拠の、本気で、絶対、温存、絶対、警察、絶対、慎重に、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're proceeding carefully with evidence preservation. Nothing will be overlooked.
lines.style: Calm reassurance. Measured, deliberate. Slight emphasis on 'carefully'—a promise, not a performance. Even breath throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 微細、本気で、絶対、な痕跡、絶対、警察、絶対、見逃さない、絶対、ですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The smallest details, the finest traces—the police won't miss them. That's certain.
lines.style: Slightly more assertive now. A note of respect in the observation. Steady, grounded. Finishing with quiet confidence, not doubt.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。立て続け、本気で、絶対、の事件、絶対、警察、絶対、関連、絶対、捜査、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively investigating the connection between these consecutive cases.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, efficient. Slight quickening on 'consecutive'—indicating urgency handled with composure. Professional continuity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 頑丈、本気で、絶対、な金庫、絶対、警察、絶対、解錠、絶対、技術、絶対、お持ちですよね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Your department does have the technical expertise to unlock even the most secure safes, I imagine.
lines.style: Respectful, almost admiring. Slightly deferential phrasing that isn't quite a question. Soft, genuine curiosity. Acknowledging competence without flattery.
